summary: This is the RobotPet family after asking the AI to add a new feature: every pet now has its own way of speaking, chosen by its battery level and its mood. Each subclass overrides both show_talent and speak, so the same method call produces a different sentence for a cat, a bird, and a dog.

lines.text: The setter is what makes the new feature trustworthy: no matter what a caller passes in, the stored battery stays between 0 and 100, so the "below 30" check in speak can never be fooled by a nonsense value.
The order of the checks is the whole logic of the feature. A low battery is tested first, so a happy pet with a nearly empty battery still asks for a charge instead of chirping cheerfully.
With enough battery, mood decides between the happy line and the plain fallback, which is the third branch every subclass repeats and every test needs to cover.

Each subclass inherits the name, battery, mood, and charge behaviour from RobotPet and only replaces the parts that differ, so adding a fourth pet type means writing two short methods rather than a whole class.
Because each subclass defines its own speak, calling pet.speak() on a list of mixed pets gives each one its own voice without any if-statement asking what type it is.
